items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: Annie Laurie is mentioned only as the title of a record: '...along with "Annie Laurie" I think was one of em'

ctx.x: B. Atlantic records came all the way out to Cleveland to record me. Yeah they made a trip out there, while I was at this place. And I made a number called "Rock the House" and it was a hit, along with "Annie Laurie" I think was one of em -- "Frankie and Johnny" probably, and a slow blues "Blue Harlem" again -- I must have made that eight times.
When did you start playing "Frankie and Johnny" and "Annie Laurie."
There was a record company in Philadelphia called Gotham. And I made quite a few sides for them.
